column1: # What the release gates do not compare (the from-raw gate, the empty-root asset gate). Any other difference fails.
# Columns (tab separated): rule · files · match · why
#   rule   json_key  drop one value of a JSON file: `match` is its dotted path from the document root (a `*` segment
#                    matches any key or list index); a path that is not in the document drops nothing
#          line      drop the lines of a text file that match the regular expression `match` (Python re.search)
#          file      the file is not compared at all (`match` = -)
#          usd_meta  clear one root-layer metadata field of a USD layer (documentation) before its text export
#   files  glob over the data-root relative path (fnmatch: `*` also crosses `/`)
#   why    why the value cannot be equal between two correct builds (a time, a place, a code identity) — required
# The comparison units are fixed in code (dexengine/release/compare.py): .npz/.npy per array (name, dtype, shape,
# bytes), .pkl by content, .json parsed, other files by bytes. One file, one reader: every gate reads these rows.
